root_idea.summary: A basic sense of joining one thing to another until it adheres to it.
root_idea.development: This joining principle extends to union rather than separation, reaching or attaining, relational affiliation, continuity, connecting means, and places of juncture. The noun وَصِيلَة also develops specialized senses involving a protected animal, prosperity, and continuous or expansive land.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form I perfect-tense citation form وَصَلَ.
Displayed under the normalized Form II citation form وَصَّلَ.
Displayed as the nominal citation form وَصِيلَةٌ.

senses.definition: 1. To join, connect, or unite things or persons.
senses.usage_conditions: In Quranic usage this includes abstract ties and whatever is commanded to be joined; the passive forms mean “be joined.”

senses.definition: 2. To reach, arrive at, or attain.
senses.usage_conditions: Used of arriving at or reaching a person, place, object, or outcome; this is distinct from the relational sense of affiliating with a people.

senses.definition: 3. To affiliate oneself with, or be related to, a people.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic construction with إِلَى in 4:90, the connection is explained relationally as being related to or associating oneself with the people, rather than merely arriving physically.

senses.definition: 1. To connect or link together repeatedly; in the Quran, to make discourse continuous by joining its parts.
senses.usage_conditions: Applied in the Quran to القول, with successive portions presented as a connected whole; the Form II pattern conveys intensive or repeated connection.

senses.definition: 1. A designated female sheep in a pre-Islamic custom: when she gave birth to a male and a female, the male was spared from slaughter because of her.
senses.usage_conditions: This is the specific customary sense in the Quranic expression وَلَا وَصِيلَةٍ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make or maintain a close bond through affection and good conduct, including with kindred.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The kinship expression وَصَلَ رَحِمَهُ refers to benevolent, affectionate treatment of relatives; the broader sense applies to a close bond generally.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To maintain loving communion or intimate relations with another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of relations of love, whether chaste or sexual; no restriction to a particular gender is implied.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A free gift, gratuity, or gift requiring no compensation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal use distinct from the relational sense of صِلَةٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause a person or thing to reach another; to convey or deliver it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Especially used with إِلَيْهِ or an equivalent destination construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To continue or maintain something without interruption.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used especially of continuing a fast without a break, and more generally of maintaining continuity rather than severing it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To engage in loving or sexual intercourse with another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A relational construction referring to intimate communion or intercourse; the source example does not impose a general object restriction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause someone or something to reach; to bring, convey, or deliver.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Often followed by the destination with إِلَى.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To apply oneself with gentleness or courtesy in order to obtain access or nearness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with إِلَيْهِ for seeking access to or nearness to someone.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To communicate with or be in communication with something or someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The supplied lexical evidence marks this usage as modern.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Union or togetherness among companions, friends, or lovers.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Opposed to separation, estrangement, or forsaking.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A limb or connecting part between two divisions.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical or structural use for a connecting part; it is distinct from the general noun وَصْلٌ meaning union.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Maintaining ties of kinship through kindness, goodness, affection, gentleness, and regard for relatives’ circumstances.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional phrase for benevolent treatment of relatives, including distant or erring relatives.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A means of connection or attachment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun for something that provides or enables a connection.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A joint or place of juncture.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes a bodily or structural point at which parts meet.
An alternative classical nominal use, distinct from the Quranic animal-custom sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An expansive tract of land, conceived as continuous or unbroken.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An alternative classical nominal use, distinct from the Quranic animal-custom sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A woman who joins her hair to other hair deceptively.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized usage reported in connection with the joining of hair.

cautions: The Form I Quranic group contains both active and passive imperfect forms; voice variation is represented within the joining/reaching senses rather than as separate headwords.

وَصِيلَةٌ has a Quran-specific animal-custom sense, while the alternative senses of prosperity and expansive land are listed separately as broader classical uses. The relational reading of يَصِلُونَ إِلَى قَوْمٍ is also kept distinct from ordinary physical reaching.
